description: Returns the federal poverty line (FPL) used for the ACA premium tax credit for a coverage year, household size and state, plus the 100%, 133%, 138%, 150%, 200%, 250%, 300% and 400% income thresholds. Coverage year Y uses the HHS guidelines published in year Y-1: 2026 coverage uses the 2025 guidelines ($15,650 for one person in the 48 states and DC, $19,550 Alaska, $17,990 Hawaii); 2025 coverage uses 2024; 2027 coverage uses 2026. Copied from the Federal Register notices, not model memory.

household_income.description: Household income in dollars for the coverage year: modified AGI of you, your spouse and dependents who must file.

household_size.description: Tax family size: you, your spouse if filing jointly, and every dependent you claim.

state.description: State of residence: two-letter code or name (AK and HI have their own poverty lines; all other states and DC share one).

name: get_federal_poverty_level
title: Federal poverty line for ACA premium tax credits
